source.name: VMMRdb
source.paper: A Large and Diverse Dataset for Improved Vehicle Make and Model Recognition (CVPR Workshops 2017)
source.image_origin: Publisher reports crawling vehicle-sale pages, mainly Craigslist and Amazon.

warnings: Archive contains 285086 images, not the publisher's stated 291752.
Archive contains 9169 classes, not the publisher's stated 9170.
At least one class has fewer than two images and cannot support an independent split.
Folder labels do not identify vehicle identity, camera, site, or capture date; leakage-safe final splitting is not proven.
Repository MIT wording does not establish ownership of the crawled third-party sale images; commercial training use is not cleared.
The archive has no declared coverage after 2017, so recent dealership inventory is unsupported.
